note: Everything a person has VERIFIED on the event's own page. A pin holds over the weekly research until `until` or until it is deleted, so the same fact is never asked twice and never overridden. `links` are the pages the person verified on. A value of "" means the page states nothing: leave it blank (the database is cleared too). See scripts/pinned_rows.py and docs/operations/QA-REGISTER.md. Only these cells may be pinned: SUBMISSION DEADLINE, DEADLINE_EVIDENCE_URL, DEADLINE_QUOTE, IS_PROJECTED, CFP_SUBMISSION_URL, STATUS DETAILS, START DATE, CONFERENCE DATES, LOCATION, CITY, STATE_PROVINCE, COUNTRY, ORGANIZER, FORMAT, MAIN_INFO_URL. Identity (event id, name, edition) and customer-owned columns never.
